segments.name: Provision of hardware and software of Internet of Things solutions
segments.description: Supplies IoT hardware and software, mainly IoT AI servers, power chargers and drones, to customers across various industries.
segments.evidence: We report our results of operations in two reportable segments dedicated to (i) the provision of hardware and software of Internet of Things solutions and (ii) investment holding.

segments.name: Investment holding
segments.description: Holds investments in the group's operating subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: We report our results of operations in two reportable segments dedicated to (i) the provision of hardware and software of Internet of Things solutions and (ii) investment holding.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for IoT products sold, with revenue from sale of goods recognized when control of the goods transfers to the customer upon delivery and acceptance.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from sale of goods is recognized at a point in time when the Group satisfies a performance obligation by transferring a promised good (i.e., an asset) to a customer.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, revenue from IoT Devices and Smart Solutions and IoT AI Software and Data Solutions fell to nil, while the new IoT AI Infrastructure category generated most revenue.
changes.evidence: Revenue from IoT Devices and Smart Solutions decreased from RM153.3 million ($36.4 million) for the year ended June 30, 2025 to RM nil for the year ended June 30, 2026.
